title: Rename billingUrl->billingEndpoint in libs/shared-contracts and update consumers (core-shell, billing, reports) in mono; platformkit unaffected

summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and its 3 consumers (core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports) in one mono PR (#1). All three apps build locally; CI and CD green. Assumptions: platform-kit has no reference to the setting so needed no change/release; shared-contracts is inlined from libs/ so no version bump or lockfile update needed.
